login.subtitle: Choose how you want to sign in to follow school health support, meals and daily routines.

role.nurseDesc: Register students, analyze meals, review records and keep families informed.
role.parentDesc: See your child's latest updates, meal reviews, schedule and wellness suggestions.

demo.exploreHint: No account needed. Opens a ready-made demo with fictional students and records.
demo.resetConfirm: This will erase all demo changes (including students you registered) and restore the original fictional demo data.

errors.network: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.upload: Unable to upload the image. Please try again.
errors.ai: AI analysis is temporarily unavailable. You can review the meal manually.
errors.noFood: No food was detected in this image. Try another photo or choose foods manually.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.studentCodeExists: A student with this ID already exists.
errors.emailInUse: This email belongs to a different kind of account. Please use another email.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
errors.demoLocked: Demo accounts cannot change their password.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.validation: Please check the information you entered.

access.title: Access restricted
access.nurseOnly: This area is only for school nurses. Your account does not have access.
access.parentOnly: This area is only for parents and guardians. Your account does not have access.

disclaimer.full: SafePulse is a student-designed prototype for educational and innovation purposes. It does not replace professional medical advice or an individual medical care plan.
disclaimer.short: SafePulse is a student-designed prototype. It does not replace professional medical advice or the individual care plan. Follow professional health guidance.

status.greenDesc: Based on the estimate, this meal looks like a good match.
status.yellowDesc: This meal may benefit from a closer look together with the student's individual care plan.
status.redDesc: This meal may require additional review based on estimated carbohydrate content and the student's individual care plan.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your account email. If it matches a parent account, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent. If email is not set up for this site, ask the school nurse for help.

changePw.title: Choose your own password
changePw.body: You signed in with a temporary password. Please set a new one to continue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

core.title: SafePulse Core
core.hint: Hover or tap an element to see how it fits together.

vision.title: AI Vision
vision.desc: Looks at a meal photo and identifies foods to estimate nutrition. Prototype estimates only.

meals.title: Meals
meals.desc: Turns each meal into a simple Good Match / Review / Needs Attention view with gentle suggestions.

glucose.title: Glucose
glucose.desc: Shows recorded glucose readings over time so families and nurses can see the bigger picture.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.desc: Keeps classes, PE, lunch and breaks in one timeline for the student's day.

school.title: School
school.desc: Brings exams and school events into view so routines can be planned ahead.

family.title: Family
family.desc: Gives each parent a private view of only their own child, with supportive notifications.

about.title: Smarter care for safer school days
about.body: SafePulse helps school nurses support students living with diabetes and keeps a clear, caring line of communication with their families — combining school health, AI-assisted meal awareness, schedules and recorded readings.
about.quote: We believe technology can transform everyday challenges into meaningful solutions.

ai.title: Real AI food recognition
ai.desc: Connect a vision model trained and tested for school meals.

portion.title: Better portion estimation
portion.desc: Improve estimates of serving sizes from photos.

monitor.title: Approved glucose monitor integrations
monitor.desc: Connect approved devices, with consent and clinical review.

cloud.title: Secure cloud deployment
cloud.desc: Managed hosting, backups and audit logs.

pro.title: Professional healthcare collaboration
pro.desc: Work with doctors and clinics to validate content.

multi.title: Multi-school deployment
multi.desc: Support many schools, each with its own team.

a11y.title: Improved accessibility
a11y.desc: More languages, voice support and reading aids.

nurse.dashboardSub: Everything you need to support students today.
nurse.todaysHint: Students with PE, exams or events
nurse.quickActions: What would you like to do?

actionHint.register: Add a student, care information and the parent account
actionHint.analyze: Upload or scan a meal with the AI Meal Scanner
actionHint.students: Search, filter and open student profiles

empty.needsReviewHint: Students whose latest meal is marked Review or Needs Attention will appear here.
empty.studentsHint: Register your first student to start tracking meals and schedules.
empty.noMatchHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.
empty.notificationsHint: New updates will show up here.
empty.mealsHint: Meal reviews appear here after the nurse analyzes a meal.
empty.scheduleHint: The school nurse can add this day's activities.
empty.scheduleHintNurse: Use "Add activity" to build this day.
empty.examsHint: Exams added by the school nurse will appear here.
empty.childrenHint: Ask the school nurse to link your child to this account.

profile.notifNote: These are the notifications sent to this student's parent account.

medical.note: Information is stored exactly as entered by the nurse. SafePulse does not create any automatic medical recommendation from these fields.
medical.medicationInfo: Medication / insulin information (according to the prescribed care plan)

insights.sub: Possible patterns found in recorded history. Awareness only — never a medical prediction.

register.title: Register Student
register.sub: Add the student, care information, school routine and the parent account in a few steps.
register.medicalNote: Enter information exactly as written in the student's care plan. SafePulse never turns it into automatic recommendations, and never calculates insulin or medication.
register.emailHint: This becomes the parent's login email.
register.emergencyHint: Name and phone of an emergency contact.
register.reviewHint: Check everything, then create the student and the parent account.
register.accountNote: A parent account will be created with a unique temporary password. The parent will be asked to choose their own password at first login.
register.doneBody: {name} is now registered and the parent account is ready.
register.showOnce: This temporary password is shown only once and is stored securely (hashed). Share it with the parent privately.
register.emailSent: A welcome email was sent to {email}.
register.emailNotConfigured: The email service is not configured, so please share the credentials with the parent yourself. You can view the prototype email below.
register.emailFailed: The email service could not deliver the message. Please share the credentials with the parent yourself.
register.previewNote: This is a preview only. This message was not sent to anyone.
register.subject: Subject
register.siblingLinked: This parent already had a SafePulse account ({email}), so the student was linked to it. No new password was created.

schedule.timeOrder: End time must be after start time.
schedule.quickFillHint: Fills Sunday–Thursday with a typical school day. Choose the PE days, then edit anything you like.

scanner.title: AI Meal Scanner
scanner.sub: Add a meal photo or choose a demo meal. SafePulse estimates nutrition and creates a supportive review for the parent.
scanner.needStudent: Register a student first, then you can analyze their meals.
scanner.drop: Drag & drop a meal photo here
scanner.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 6 MB
scanner.cameraDenied: Camera is not available. You can pick a photo instead.
scanner.demoModeNote: AI vision is not connected, so uploaded photos use a clearly-labelled demo estimate. Connect an AI API key to enable real food recognition.
scanner.demoMealsHint: Tap a demo meal to see the full flow without a photo.
scanner.manualHint: Select the foods on the plate. SafePulse will estimate nutrition from typical portions.
scanner.parentNotifiedHint: A "Meal Review" notification was added to the parent's dashboard.
scanner.noParent: No parent account is linked to this student, so no notification was created.

meal.estimateNote: Estimates only — not exact nutritional values.
meal.demoStandIn: The foods shown for this uploaded photo are a demo stand-in until an AI vision service is connected.
meal.safetyNurse: Review the student's individual care plan. SafePulse never calculates insulin or medication. Follow professional health guidance.
meal.safetyParent: This is a general awareness estimate. Review the student's individual care plan and follow professional health guidance.

glucose.recordsNote: These are readings recorded by the school. They are shown for awareness and do not replace the care plan or professional advice.
glucose.invalid: Enter a whole number between 20 and 600.

chart.glucoseAria: Line chart of recorded glucose readings over time
chart.weeklyHint: Average recorded reading for each school day.
chart.weeklyAria: Bar chart of average glucose by weekday
chart.dayTypeHint: Average reading on exam days, PE days and other days.
chart.dayTypeAria: Bar chart comparing average glucose on exam days, PE days and other days
chart.carbHint: Prototype estimates. Bar colour shows the meal status.
chart.carbAria: Bar chart of estimated carbohydrates for recent meals

notif.subNurse: Follow-ups for you, such as meals that were flagged for review.
notif.subParent: Supportive updates from your child's school nurse.

patterns.title: Possible Patterns
patterns.label: Possible pattern — not a medical prediction.
patterns.noCausation: These are statistics about past records. They do not show that one thing causes another.
patterns.notEnough: More recorded readings are needed before patterns can be shown.
patterns.noneHint: Nothing stands out in the recorded history.
patterns.safety: Patterns are for awareness only. Follow professional health guidance and the individual care plan.

wellness.title: My Wellness Plan
wellness.sub: General, supportive ideas for everyday routines.
wellness.cardHint: Meals, hydration, sleep, activity and more
wellness.intro: These are general wellness ideas only. They are not medical advice and never include insulin, medication, diagnosis or treatment.

parent.mealsSub: Recent meal assessments and gentle suggestions.
